attempts.observation: OpenCode exited before inference because the Codex task sandbox denied a write to the owner's OpenCode log under Application Support. No model session was created.
A disposable test-only redirect of OpenCode state into /private/tmp reached native startup but failed the guarded-shell startup canary before inference.

nested_sandbox_probe.meaning: The Codex task environment cannot apply even this diagnostic macOS sandbox profile. KRYN's guarded native shell requires sandbox-exec, so this task environment cannot exercise it without changing the execution environment.

interpretation: These are execution-environment blockers, not successful KRYN product trials or evidence of model quality. The isolated redirect is not the owner installation and cannot qualify it. The direct OS probe explains why a guarded-shell trial cannot pass inside this task sandbox; the product guard and canary were not bypassed.
